## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

List the relevant checks you ran and their results. For documentation changes,
check links and instructions. For interface changes, include a screenshot when
useful and verify English/Vietnamese labels at compact window sizes.

Follow [product guidelines](https://github.com/10s3r2604/supodownloadmanager/blob/main/docs/PRODUCT_GUIDELINES.md) and preserve dependency
licenses. Do not include private signing keys, cookies or credential-bearing URLs.
